name: canlang
description: CanLang: AI-native SaaS DSL on workerd. Root bun workspace (lane 07 integrates).

scripts.build: bun run build:joins && tsc -b packages/contracts && bun run --filter @canlang/work-kernel build && bun run --filter @canlang/identity build && bun run --filter @canlang/ui build && bun run --filter @canlang/interfaces build && tsc -b packages/state packages/stdlib packages/testkit packages/cloudflare && chmod +x packages/cloudflare/dist/cli/platform.js
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run release:stamp && bun run release:manifest && bun run release:verify
